title: Songwriting Extension
intro: Use the words students collected from Triple C to create an original school song with a partner.

items.title: Write
items.text: Students write 3–5 sentences using words from their song vocabulary list.

items.title: Create together
items.text: Partners combine their ideas into a short verse and chorus.

items.title: Share
items.text: Invite volunteers to perform or read their songs.

source_note: Adapted from original Full Guide School Song teacher page (page 27), steps 4–6; original activity options preserved and made optional.
